article.title: Discharge of person apprehended
article.content: No person who has been arrested by a police officer shall be discharged except on his bond, or bail bond, or under the special order of a Magistrate.
article.html:
60Discharge of person apprehended

Section 60 · Chapter V

No person who has been arrested by a police officer shall be discharged except on his bond, or bail bond, or under the special order of a Magistrate.
